title: Polish Trout with Pilaf
description: A flavorful and light German-inspired dish featuring pan-seared trout served with a side of Polish-style pilaf.
instructions: Rinse the trout fillets and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together the butter, polish rye bread crumbs, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Place the trout fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle the butter mixture evenly over the trout fillets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the trout is baking, heat a tablespoon of butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cooked pilaf to the saucepan and stir to combine with the butter.
Serve the pan-seared trout with the Polish-style pilaf and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Garnish with lemon wedges and serve immediately.
